# Battlefield Card

Battle · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/battlefield-card`

Source-module importers: **1** (value imports outside docs and test/type fixtures; not a production-liveness measure).

The complete face-up battle-instance presentation for exhaustion, memory, figments, selection, challenge markers, score announcements, press, and pointer drag.

> **Guidance:** The board owns legality and drop geometry; this component emits semantic battle-instance intent.

Passive, pressable, and draggable variants form a closed interaction union while GameCard remains the reveal owner.

The caller owns board geometry and battle legality; quick press and deliberate drag report only battle-instance intent.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `BattlefieldCardModel` | yes | — | Complete prepared battle-instance presentation. |
| `interaction` | `BattlefieldCardInteraction` | yes | — | Closed interaction behavior prepared by the board. |

### `model`: the `BattlefieldCardModel` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `battleCardId` | `BattleCardId` | no | Stable battle-instance identity used by every interaction callback. |
| `card` | `GameCardModel` | no | Complete resolved game-card presentation. |
| `exhausted` | `boolean` | no | Whether the battle instance is exhausted. |
| `storedMemory` | `number` | no | Prepared stored-memory count shown on the card. |
| `figment` | `boolean` | no | Whether to use the canonical Figment treatment. |
| `selection` | `GameCardSelection` | yes | Optional semantic selection treatment prepared by the board. |
| `challengeMarker` | `{ readonly owner: "player" \| "enemy"; readonly side: "near" \| "far"; }` | yes | Optional challenge ownership and viewer-relative orientation. |
| `scoreAnnouncement` | `{ readonly points: number; readonly presentationId: PresentationId; }` | yes | Optional score announcement attached to this battle instance. |
| `motion` | `"snap" \| "travel"` | no | Named layout-motion behavior for board travel. |
| `presentation` | `"battlefield" \| "full"` | no | Canonical compact battlefield or complete-card presentation. |

### `interaction`: the `BattlefieldCardInteraction` model

| Field | Type | Optional | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"passive" \| "pressable" \| "draggable"` | no | Readable card with no board action. Keyboard- and pointer-pressable card. Pointer-draggable card with optional quick-press behavior. |

## Usage

```tsx
<BattlefieldCard model={preparedCard} interaction={{ kind: "pressable", onPress }} />
```
